brief:
为 Guerlain Shalimar 制作高品质商业香水海报。保留上传商品原貌与可见标签；为这款商品形成四个真正不同的创意方向。只使用品牌与产品名称，不添加价格、容量、促销、新品或功效宣传。
本次必须采用以下独立艺术方向，优先于通用风格要求；保留用户商品、文案和禁止事项：A flat lapidary poster: deep lapis field inlaid with a fine gold star-lattice intarsia, one large hard-edge midnight octagon centred upper-middle like a vault panel behind the dome cap. The cutout is lifted into the upper two-thirds so the lower third becomes a quiet plaque band with real breathing room above it: a thin gold inlay seam, tracked brand line, then the Baskerville name set wide and centred at near band width. Stone matte against glossy blue dome and glowing amber tells the story entirely through inlay geometry.

references.selection_reason: Highly resolved commercial perfume advertisement featuring dramatic floral explosion, strong contrast, and clear campaign typography.

analysis.composition: Asymmetrical balance with the faceted bottle anchored lower-left against an exploding rose, counterweighted by right-aligned typography in the negative space.
analysis.negative_space: Dark, textured void on the right utilized effectively for legible white text placement.
analysis.lighting: Dramatic studio lighting with high contrast; sharp specular highlights on the geometric glass facets and soft, directional light defining the rose petals.
analysis.typography: Clean, sans-serif and serif mix in white; prominent '007' logo lockup with supporting tagline and URL, distinctly separate from the product container.
analysis.information_density: Moderate; focuses on brand identity, product name, and evocative tagline without clutter.

references.selection_reason: Professionally resolved perfume still-life with high-end lighting and material detail, suitable as a design reference for luxury fragrance campaigns.

analysis.composition: Centered single-subject composition on a reflective surface against a gradient backdrop.
analysis.negative_space: Ample negative space above and around the bottle, filled with a smooth golden gradient.
analysis.lighting: Soft, diffused studio lighting creating specular highlights on the glass edges and metallic cap, with a clear reflection below.
analysis.typography: None. Text is limited to the brand label printed directly on the glass container.
analysis.information_density: Low, focusing entirely on the product form and material.

references.selection_reason: Highly resolved conceptual still-life featuring a Cartier fragrance integrated with vintage Edison bulbs. Strong visual metaphor and premium execution make it an excellent design reference.

analysis.composition: Symmetrical arrangement with the perfume bottle centered among hanging lightbulbs at varying heights, mirrored on a reflective surface below.
analysis.negative_space: Deep teal gradient background provides clean negative space around the illuminated subjects.
analysis.lighting: Dramatic practical lighting from the glowing filaments combined with a soft central backlight creating a halo effect behind the bottle.
analysis.typography: None. The text on the bottle is container labeling, not campaign typography.
analysis.information_density: Low, focused entirely on the visual concept and product.
